title: OracleQuorumConfigResponse
description: Response for oracle quorum configuration query.

OracleQuorumConfig.description: Multi-oracle quorum configuration for redundancy median resolution.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the stored quorum price in seconds before it is considered stale for settlement purposes.

max_deviation_bps.description: Maximum allowed price deviation between the highest and lowest prices in the qualifying quorum window, in basis points (e.g. 500 = 5%).

min_quorum_k.description: Minimum number of submitted prices that must agree within `max_deviation_bps` to form a valid quorum.
